scope: Known invented development regression cases. These are not independent evaluation or reviewer-approved training labels.

cases.text: A warehouse turret truck charger rests on a platform six feet above an aisle. It is not bolted down and can be moved easily.
A charger is on an elevated platform without mounting bolts. It can slide toward the aisle.
A charger on an elevated shelf is secured by its approved retaining bracket. No person is working on the shelf.
An unplugged battery charger is loose on a high shelf above an occupied aisle.
A pump stands on a high platform without mounting bolts. No employee is on the platform.
The sling has no broken wires and remains in service.
A wire-rope sling with broken outer wires remained in an active lift.
No oil spill is present on the walkway.
An oil spill remains on the employee walkway.
A worker is beside an equipment cabinet. The image does not show whether it is energized or isolated.
The image does not show whether the platform has a guardrail.
A worker can reach an exposed rotating shaft on a production machine. The guard is missing.
Unfamiliar equipment in an occupied aisle has begun rattling and moving unexpectedly.
